Audio pads: AUDIO_IN_1/2 = `SEED_IN_L/R`, OUT 1 = left (+/-), OUT 2 = right (+/-), VCOM = `VCOM_SEED`.

All 33 pins are used. D1-D6 = SDMMC1 (4-bit microSD, as the Seed3 Eurorack Dev Kit), D29 / D30 = USB HS (the panel USB-C: USB MIDI; **firmware update over it is NOT settled**: the STM32 ROM DFU listens on the Seed's own micro-USB), D22 / D23 (the Seed's DACs) are GPIO because the CV outs are on an MCP4728. D16 is output only (clock out). The OLED's CS is tied low in hardware; its RES is on `U_IO3`.

## I2C devices (I2C1, 4.7K pull-ups, 400 kHz to 1 MHz)

Address | Device | Job
--- | --- | ---
0x20 | MCP23017 `U_IO1` | GPA0=ENC1_A, GPA1=ENC1_B, GPA2=ENC1_SW, GPA3=ENC2_A, GPA4=ENC2_B, GPA5=ENC2_SW, GPA6=ENC3_A, GPA7=ENC3_B, GPB0=ENC3_SW, GPB1=ENC4_A, GPB2=ENC4_B, GPB3=ENC4_SW, GPB4=BTN1, GPB5=BTN2, GPB6=BTN3, GPB7=BTN4. INTA / INTB are open drain, wired together to `I2C_INT` (D23). Inputs: enable the internal pull-ups (GPPU); all switches are plain switches to GND (the standard Bourns encoders have no LED).
0x21 | MCP23017 `U_IO2` | GPA0=BTN5, GPA1=BTN6, GPA2=BTN7, GPA3=BTN8, GPA4=BTN9, GPA5=BTN10, GPA6=MX1, GPA7=MX2, GPB0=MX3, GPB1=MX4, GPB2=MX5, GPB3=MX6, GPB4=MX7, GPB5=MX8. INTA / INTB are open drain, wired together to `I2C_INT` (D23). Inputs: enable the internal pull-ups (GPPU); all switches are plain switches to GND (the standard Bourns encoders have no LED).
0x22 | MCP23017 `U_IO3` | GPA0=MUX_A, GPA1=MUX_B, GPA2=MUX_C, GPA3=LED_OE, GPA4=OLED_RES. INTA / INTB are open drain, wired together to `I2C_INT` (D23). Inputs: enable the internal pull-ups (GPPU); all switches are plain switches to GND (the standard Bourns encoders have no LED).
0x60 | MCP4728 `U_DAC1` | 4-channel 12-bit DAC: **A = CV out 1, B = CV out 2** (C, D spare), VDD 3V3, internal 2.048 V reference, gain 1; the op-amp stage scales to 0 .. 5 V (`CVO_RF` / `CVO_RG` in design.py). Control rate (about 1 kHz). LDAC tied low. Write the CV first and raise a gate 1 to 2 ms later.
0x40 | PCA9685 `U_LED1` | LED0=LED_BTN1_R_K, LED1=LED_BTN1_G_K, LED2=LED_BTN1_B_K, LED3=LED_BTN2_R_K, LED4=LED_BTN2_G_K, LED5=LED_BTN2_B_K, LED6=LED_BTN3_R_K, LED7=LED_BTN3_G_K, LED8=LED_BTN3_B_K, LED9=LED_BTN4_R_K, LED10=LED_BTN4_G_K, LED11=LED_BTN4_B_K, LED12=LED_BTN5_R_K, LED13=LED_BTN5_G_K, LED14=LED_BTN5_B_K, LED15=LED_PTL1_K (open drain, common-anode LEDs on +5V_LED, `LED_OE` high = off)
0x41 | PCA9685 `U_LED2` | LED0=LED_BTN6_R_K, LED1=LED_BTN6_G_K, LED2=LED_BTN6_B_K, LED3=LED_BTN7_R_K, LED4=LED_BTN7_G_K, LED5=LED_BTN7_B_K, LED6=LED_BTN8_R_K, LED7=LED_BTN8_G_K, LED8=LED_BTN8_B_K, LED9=LED_BTN9_R_K, LED10=LED_BTN9_G_K, LED11=LED_BTN9_B_K, LED12=LED_BTN10_R_K, LED13=LED_BTN10_G_K, LED14=LED_BTN10_B_K, LED15=LED_PTL2_K (open drain, common-anode LEDs on +5V_LED, `LED_OE` high = off)

PCA9685: set OUTDRV = 0 (open drain), clear ALLCALL; the MCP4728 and the PCA9685 both answer the I2C general call: check the datasheets before sending a general-call reset.

## SK6812 chain (8 x SK6812-EC20 under the MX keys)

`LED_DATA` (D9) -> 74AHCT1G125 on +5V_LED (`U_LS1`) -> 33R -> key 1 DIN ... key 8 DIN. Drive it from a timer + DMA (or SPI), 800 kHz; keep the brightness low (the 5 V budget).

## Panel analog (74HC4051 `U_MUX1`, ADC on D15, select lines `MUX_A/B/C` from `U_IO3`)

Channel | Control
--- | ---
0 | PTL1 wiper (Bourns PTL20, left)
1 | PTL2 wiper (Bourns PTL20, right)
2 | Alps RS6011 slider (60 mm)
3 | VR1 (trim, left)
4 | VR2 (trim, right)
5 | VR3 (regular pot, left)
6 | VR4 (regular pot, right)
7 | free

## Notes for the firmware

- External codec PCM3060 on SAI2 in H/W mode: slave, 24-bit left-justified, single-ended, de-emphasis off. The Seed drives MCLK/SCK/FS (SAI2 block B master), SD_A = DAC data to the codec, SD_B = ADC data from it. Check against libDaisy's Daisy Patch SAI2 set-up.
- CV in (4): inverting stage, +-5 V maps to 3.3 .. 0 V (invert in firmware). Gate in (2) and clock in (1): inverting transistor stage (a high gate reads 0). Clock in is on D0 (EXTI12), gate in 1 / 2 on D19 / D32.
- CV out (2): MCP4728, 0 .. 5 V, control rate. Gate out (2) and clock out (1): 0 / 5 V buffers on D20 / D22 / D16, set from the audio callback (a small block size keeps the jitter low) or a timer.
- MIDI TX should be open drain if the HAL allows it (a mono TS cable in the TRS jack shorts the ring to the sleeve).
- OLED: SPI1 write-only, 4-wire (SCK D8, MOSI D10, D/C D7), CS tied low, RES from `U_IO3` GPB. The 0.96 in module is an SSD1315; the 1.3 in (alternative in KicadLibs) is an SH1106 (libDaisy has `oled_sh1106.h`).
